Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows hypoxemia, mild anemia, leukopenia with neutropenia and lymphopenia, thrombocytopenia, monocytosis, basophilia, and mild hyperchloremia. These findings may indicate bone marrow suppression or infiltration, possible infection, or systemic disease. Clinical correlation and further diagnostic workup are recommended to clarify the underlying cause.
